comment: Attachment points are in shufle.glb local units (after its +90deg X node rotation; front faces +Z). Measured by ray probes: slot opening x -0.26..0.25, y 0.185..0.237, recess back z 0.28; card platform in the top tray: x -0.20..0.20, rear edge z -0.20 y 0.497, front edge z 0.24 y 0.453; deck = centre of the bottom card resting on both edges.
